thresholds.rule: Low: LST < μ−0.5σ · Moderate: μ−0.5σ ≤ LST < μ+0.5σ · High: μ+0.5σ ≤ LST < μ+1.5σ · Very High: LST ≥ μ+1.5σ

summary.method: Severity from μ/σ thresholds on observed cell-mean LST (model prediction where LST is missing); spatial clustering by Getis-Ord Gi* (3x3 queen contiguity, z ≥ 1.96 ⇒ significant at 95 %).
